title: Narx va miqdorni so'rash
can_do: Narxni va miqdorni so'ray olasiz va javobni tushunasiz
why: Bozorda, do'konda, kafeda — narxni so'ramasdan xarid qilib bo'lmaydi. Ikkita savol so'zini adashtirish esa eng ko'p uchraydigan xato.

points.text: How many sanaladigan otlar bilan ishlatiladi va ot ko'plikda turadi: How many apples? How many people?

examples.en: How many brothers have you got?

points.text: How much sanalmaydigan otlar bilan ishlatiladi va ot birlikda qoladi: How much water? How much time?

examples.en: How much sugar do you want?
How much time have we got?

points.text: Narx so'raganda doim how much ishlatiladi — pul sanalmaydigan hisoblanadi. «How much is it?» — eng kerakli savol.
Miqdorni aytishda: a lot of — ko'p (ikkalasi bilan ham), a few — bir nechta (sanaladigan), a little — ozgina (sanalmaydigan).

examples.en: I have a few friends here.
examples.uz: Bu yerda bir nechta do'stim bor.

examples.en: There are a lot of shops.

common_errors.wrong: How much apples do you want?
common_errors.right: How many apples do you want?

common_errors.wrong: How many money have you got?
common_errors.right: How much money have you got?

common_errors.why: Narx doim how much bilan so'raladi.

common_errors.right: How much is this book? / How much does this book cost?
common_errors.why: Cost fe'li bilan does kerak, aks holda is ishlatiladi.

words.example: There are a lot of shops.

practice_spec.note: Mashqlarni AI shu spetsifikatsiya bo'yicha yaratadi. Tur raqamlari — docs/mashqlar.md dagi shkala.

items.focus: how much yoki how many ni tanlash
a few / a little / a lot of ni otga qarab tanlash
«How much apples», «How many money» xatolarini topish
o'zbekchadan tarjima: «Bu qancha turadi?», «Nechta akangiz bor?»

final.task: Bozorda savdolashyapsiz. Sotuvchi bilan suhbatni yozing: narx so'rash, miqdor aytish, qaytim. 6 gap.

skill_task.task: Bozorda savdo bo'lmoqda. Mahsulot, miqdor va narxni yozing.
